description: Set an account's weekly posting times (slots, in the workspace timezone), its default first comment and hashtags, its Trial Reels autopilot, and what automatic placement keeps to (quiet_days, max_per_day), and a weekly goal (weekly_target: posts a week, 1 to 21, null clears it; accounts_list week_rhythm shows done, scheduled and short_by this week). Pass only what changes. A post approved without a time goes out at the account's next best slot, keeping to these. With trial_reels on, each Trial Reel runs run_hours, then the best of each test (options.instagram.trial_test) by pick_by goes to followers as the settings say; trial_reels_list shows the results.

first_comment.description: Posted as the first comment where the network allows it. null clears it.

hashtags.description: Default hashtags drafts for this account should carry.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

max_per_day.description: At most this many posts a day placed automatically on this account. null: only the network's own daily limit.

pinterest_board_id.description: Pinterest: the board Pins go to when a post doesn't pick one (pinterest_boards lists them).

quiet_days.description: Weekdays nothing is placed on automatically, 0 = Sunday (e.g. [0, 6] for weekends off). A time someone picks still goes. [] clears them.

rules.description: Who writes each part of posts here: caption, hashtags, cover and replies, "assistant" or "person". person: you leave that part to them; a post going here opens a task on Home for it (task_ask is done for you), and if_open says what the post does if it's still open at its time: hold, post (as drafted) or skip. Read them in accounts_list settings.rules before drafting, and follow them. Pass only what changes.

replies.description: person: comment answers wait in Inbox for a person, never sent by an assistant

slots.description: e.g. [{days:[1,3,5], time:"19:00"}]. [] clears them, so the account follows the workspace's posting times or the suggested ones.

trial_reels.description: Instagram: the Trial Reels autopilot. Pass only what changes; turning it on the first time picks then: post when you may approve posts, else approve.

beat_typical.description: A winner must also beat the account's typical Trial Reel on pick_by: the median of its last 20 judged ones, once it has 5. Default true

min_views.description: A winner needs at least this many views. Default 500

on.description: Turn the autopilot on or off

pick_by.description: What wins: shares (shares per 1,000 people reached, Instagram's strongest signal for reaching non-followers; the default), watch_time (average watch time), likes (per 1,000 reached) or views

run_hours.description: How long each Trial Reel runs before it's judged, in hours (24 to 168). Default 72, the window Instagram's own auto-share uses

then.description: post: a winner goes to followers as a new Reel at the account's next posting time, under your approval (needs the right to approve posts); approve: the new Reel waits for approval; tell: a notice to share the original in Instagram, which keeps its views (Instagram's API can't share it)

winners.description: How many from one test go to followers, 1 to 3. Default 1

weekly_target.description: Posts a week you want on this account. null clears the goal. accounts_list week_rhythm shows how the week is going.

name: account_settings_update
title: Set posting times and defaults
